title: Kiewa, VIC - Upgrade the Network
current_summary: Planned network upgrades in Kiewa, VIC have now been completed. Services impacted by this maintenance should be restored. If you are still experiencing issues, please restart your equipment or contact support for assistance. Thank you for your patience during these works.

updates.content:
We’re notifying customers in Kiewa, VIC of planned Fixed Wireless network upgrades by one of our upstream providers. During this work, some services may lose connection.

Planned interruptions:
- Tue 15 Sep, 8:00 AM–12:00 PM AEST (up to 4 hours)
- Wed 16 Sep, 8:00 AM–12:00 PM AEST (up to 4 hours)

The overall maintenance window runs until Sat 19 Sep, 5:00 PM AEST and timings may move within this window. If possible, please plan ahead for any critical activities and consider using mobile data as a backup during the interruptions. We’ll keep monitoring and will update you if the schedule changes. Thank you for your patience.

The planned maintenance works in Kiewa, VIC have been updated. The overall maintenance window remains scheduled until Saturday 19 September at 5:00 PM AEST. Please plan accordingly and consider using mobile data during the possible interruptions. We will continue to monitor and provide any further updates as needed.

The planned network maintenance in Kiewa, VIC has begun and is now in progress. Customers may experience service interruptions while works continue through to Saturday 19 September at 5:00 PM AEST. We recommend planning ahead and using mobile data if necessary. Further updates will be shared if the schedule or expected impact changes.
